sharedRules.name: Blessings of Khorne
sharedRules.description:
At the start of the battle round, you may use this ability, once per battle round per army, if your Army Faction is WORLD EATERS, until the end of the battle round:
  -> Roll 8D6; allocate dice to activate up to 2 of the following:
    - Unbridled Bloodlust (requires pair of 1+): the unit gets +1 to Charge rolls.
    - Rage-Fuelled Invigoration (requires pair of 2+): add 3" to the unit's Pile-in and Consolidation moves.
    - Total Carnage (requires pair of 3+): when a friendly model is destroyed in melee: each time a model in this unit is destroyed, unless that unit has fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield; after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, it can fight. Remove it after it has fought.
    - Martial Excellence (requires pair of 4+ or triple of 1+): melee weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
    - Warp Blades (requires pair of 5+ or triple of 2+): melee weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [LETHAL HITS].
    - Decapitating Strikes (requires pair of 6+ or triple of 3+): while making melee attacks against INFANTRY targets, the unit's weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

    - Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by friendly CHARACTER models in the triggering unit by 1.
Applies to: units with WORLD EATERS, CHARACTER (excluding EPIC HERO).

rules.name: Blood Tithe
rules.description:
For the rest of the battle:
  -> Each time an enemy unit is destroyed:
    -> Roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point.
  -> At the start of the Command phase:
    Select one of the following (Blood Tithe Abilities):
      - Spend 2 Blood Tithe points; all friendly units with the BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS keyword have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.
      - Spend 3 Blood Tithe points; melee weapons equipped by all friendly BLOOD LEGIONS units gain [LANCE].
      - Spend 4 Blood Tithe points; all friendly BLOOD LEGIONS units have a 4+ invulnerable save.
      - Spend 5 Blood Tithe points; all friendly BLOOD LEGIONS units gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.

rules.name: Idols of Khorne
rules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you may use this ability, until the start of your next Command phase:
  -> Select one (each may be chosen once per battle):
    - Idol of Infinite Rage: while a friendly unit with the GOREMONGERS or JAKHALS keyword is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS models with at least one of MONSTER or TITANIC without TITANIC, that unit gets +1 to Hit rolls; that unit gets +1 to Wound rolls; while a friendly unit with the GOREMONGERS or JAKHALS keyword is within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC models with at least one of MONSTER or TITANIC, that unit gets +1 to Hit rolls; that unit gets +1 to Wound rolls.
    - Idol of Burning Wrath: while a friendly unit with the GOREMONGERS or JAKHALS keyword is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS models with at least one of MONSTER or TITANIC without TITANIC, add 1 to that unit's Move characteristic; that unit gets +1 to Advance rolls; that unit gets +1 to Charge rolls; while a friendly unit with the GOREMONGERS or JAKHALS keyword is within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC models with at least one of MONSTER or TITANIC, add 1 to that unit's Move characteristic; that unit gets +1 to Advance rolls; that unit gets +1 to Charge rolls.
    - Idol of Blessed Blood: while a friendly unit with the GOREMONGERS or JAKHALS keyword is within 6" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS models with at least one of MONSTER or TITANIC without TITANIC, that unit has a 4+ invulnerable save; while a friendly unit with the GOREMONGERS or JAKHALS keyword is within 9" of one or more friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC models with at least one of MONSTER or TITANIC, that unit has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Rush to the Fray
rules.description:
When a friendly unit disembarks from a Transport (the triggering unit must have WORLD EATERS), until the end of the turn:
  -> The triggering unit gets +1 to Charge rolls.
  -> Melee weapons equipped by the triggering unit gain [LANCE].

rules.name: Rampaging Terrors
rules.description:
All friendly DAEMON VEHICLE units gain the Terror of Khorne ability:
  -> At the start of the Fight phase, you may use this ability:
    -> Select one enemy unit if the selected unit is a unit within Engagement Range of the unit (each unit can be selected for this ability at most once per phase across your army): that unit must take a Battle-shock test, applying -1 to that test.
You cannot select this Detachment together with another ONSLAUGHT Detachment.
Applies to: units with DAEMON, VEHICLE.

rules.name: Adamantine Avalanche
rules.description:
At the start of the Fight phase, while a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD unit is engaged, until the end of the phase, make a new Blessings of Khorne roll and activate one result it allows for all friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD units, in addition to any already active.
Applies to: units with TERMINATOR SQUAD.
